_provenance.reference: imsg watch.subscribe notification envelope (https://github.com/steipete/imsg/blob/main/docs/rpc.md, 'watch.subscribe') wrapping the Message object (https://github.com/steipete/imsg/blob/main/docs/json.md, 'Message'). Values are synthetic; only the FIELD NAMES and types are the claim.
_provenance.note: Transcribed from published docs, NOT captured from a live Mac -- a live probe needs macOS with Messages signed in, Full Disk Access, and a real handle, so it cannot run in CI. The load-bearing fields are the ones the parser reads: id (the cursor rowid -- NOT named 'rowid'), guid (dedupe key), sender, text, is_from_me, is_group, and the three chat selectors.
